introduction: Explore product appeal and purchase barriers with AI-powered research respondents.
details: Open a product, choose a saved Audience of AI-powered Minds, and review four research questions before starting a Study. Explore product appeal, price hesitation, missing information and presentation ideas. Read respondent excerpts and continue research in Minds. Results are synthetic feedback, not observed customer behavior or guaranteed sales outcomes. A linked Minds account and available response allowance are required. The research questions are currently in English.
features: Start product research from a product's details in your admin.
Choose a saved Audience of AI-powered research respondents.
Review four questions and response usage before starting a Study.
